content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make a bow tie, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Cut the main silk fabric to pattern dimensions (5 minutes)
Step 2. Cut the stiffening interfacing for the neck strap (4 minutes)
Step 3. Iron the interfacing onto the back of the bow sections (3 minutes)
Step 4. Baste the edges of the fabric to prevent fraying (10 minutes)
Step 5. Pin the front and back fabric pieces right sides together (6 minutes)
Step 6. Stitch along the marked seam allowance (12 minutes)
Step 7. Trim the excess fabric from the seam corners (3 minutes)
Step 8. Clip the curves of the bow to allow for easy turning (5 minutes)
Step 9. Turn the bow tie right side out through the center gap (8 minutes)
Step 10. Press the stitched seams flat with a steam iron (4 minutes)
Step 11. Measure the wearer's neck circumference (2 minutes)
Step 12. Draft the custom bow tie template on cardstock (15 minutes)
Step 13. Hand-sew the small opening used for turning (15 minutes)
Step 14. Select the matching thread color for topstitching (2 minutes)
Step 15. Check the symmetry of the bow loops (1 minute)
Step 16. Clean and oil the sewing machine (20 minutes)
Step 17. Attach the metal slide adjuster to the strap (5 minutes)
Step 18. Wind a fresh bobbin with silk thread (3 minutes)
Step 19. Insert the bobbin into the machine case (1 minute)
Step 20. Thread the upper needle of the machine (2 minutes)
Step 21. Cut the adjustable neck strap fabric (3 minutes)
Step 22. Give the entire tie a final professional press (5 minutes)
Step 23. Mark the positions for the hook and eye fasteners (4 minutes)
Step 24. Fold the strap edges inward and press (6 minutes)
Step 25. Align the strap with the center of the bow (4 minutes)
Step 26. Sharpen the fabric shears (10 minutes)
Step 27. Test the stitch tension on a scrap piece of silk (3 minutes)
Step 28. Remove all temporary basting threads (7 minutes)
Step 29. Organize the workspace and layout tools (10 minutes)
Step 30. Cut a small piece of fabric for the center knot loop (2 minutes)
Step 31. Purchase the silk fabric and interfacing (2 hours)
Step 32. Apply fray-check liquid to the raw edges (15 minutes)
Step 33. Hand-stitch the label onto the back of the strap (10 minutes)
Step 34. Grade the seam allowances to reduce bulk (8 minutes)
Step 35. Sew the hook and eye onto the strap ends (12 minutes)
Step 36. Notch the seam allowance at the pivot points (5 minutes)
Step 37. Slide the finished bow through the neck strap loop (2 minutes)
Step 38. Inspect the fabric for any factory defects (5 minutes)
Step 39. Steam the fabric to remove shipping creases (10 minutes)
Step 40. Measure and cut the elastic portion if using (3 minutes)
Step 41. Interface the neck strap for stability (6 minutes)
Step 42. Thread the strap through the adjustment buckle (4 minutes)
Step 43. Form the permanent knot shape by hand (8 minutes)
Step 44. Trace the template onto the silk fabric (10 minutes)
Step 45. Replace the sewing machine needle with a microtex point (2 minutes)
Step 46. Sketch the desired bow tie style (20 minutes)
Step 47. Tack the bow loops to the center knot (5 minutes)
Step 48. Pre-shrink the silk fabric with a dry iron (15 minutes)
Step 49. Clean the work table surface (5 minutes)
Step 50. Prepare the workspace lighting (2 minutes)
Step 51. Turn the center loop piece right side out (4 minutes)
Step 52. Select the appropriate needle size for hand sewing (1 minute)
Step 53. Measure the width of the bow wings (3 minutes)
Step 54. Assemble the hardware components (5 minutes)
Step 55. Edge-stitch the neck strap for a crisp finish (10 minutes)
Step 56. Calibrate the measuring tape (1 minute)
Step 57. Secure the thread ends with a hidden knot (3 minutes)
Step 58. Wipe the iron base to ensure it is clean (2 minutes)
Step 59. Unroll the bolt of silk (2 minutes)
Step 60. Check the elastic tension (2 minutes)
